topPros.title: plain white rice is easy on many stomachs
topPros.explanation: Its lower fibre and blandness make it a practical recovery or tolerance food for some people, which is more specific than generic convenience.

topPros.title: cheap and easy to scale as a staple
topPros.explanation: White rice earns real-world value from being affordable, shelf-stable, and easy to cook in large batches.

topPros.title: neutral enough to pair with almost anything
topPros.explanation: That flexibility helps explain why it stays common even when its nutrient density is limited.

topCons.explanation: That is the central reason white rice scores worse than intact whole grains.

topCons.title: carb quality changes a lot with rice type and preparation
topCons.explanation: That makes the exact glycemic story hard to lock honestly from a single dry-rice record.

scenes.narrationText: The upsides first: plain white rice is easy on many stomachs. Its lower fibre and blandness make it a practical recovery or tolerance food for some people, which is more specific than generic convenience. Cheap and easy to scale as a staple. White rice earns real-world value from being affordable, shelf-stable, and easy to cook in large batches. Neutral enough to pair with almost anything. That flexibility helps explain why it stays common even when its nutrient density is limited.
